description: The substation image research team publishes a Python adaptation of DeepLabV3+ for training and prediction with custom semantic-segmentation datasets. It extends an existing PyTorch implementation with a dataset loader, epoch tracking, resumable checkpoints and text logging. The README specifies image and colour-mask conventions, model options and command-line examples. Source code is free under the MIT licence. This globally applicable implementation can classify substation equipment to prepare infrastructure inventories or digital-twin inputs, but it does not model electricity-network behaviour. Training needs labelled imagery and suitable computing resources; model accuracy and installation were not tested here. No directly related catalogue platform was identified.
name: Custom DeepLabV3+ implementation for substation imagery
